title: Aeronautics: Shafts and Gears
description: Aeronautics Shafts and Gears is a modpack based on create mod and create aeronautics with addons to complement the ultimate create experience.
body:
Aeronautics Shafts and Gears is a medium-weight modpack built around the Create mod and Create: Aeronautics, with a lot of addons that complete the experience for automation and a ircraft  you made, combined with Regions Unexplored for new biomes and a new Nether and End to provide a stunning backdrop for your aerial empire. Build automated factories, design fully functional physics-based airships and chart a course through beautiful and revamped dimensions. 

Optimized with Sodium, Lithium, C2me, fast noise and Immediately Fast as core performance boosters with Iris include.

You will also find mods like Supplementaries a revamped Nether and End and Farmer's Delight recipes to keep the gameplay fresh and far from monotonous.
